free_tier.stated: SIT & GRE and WireGuard tunnels - routed ::/64 prefix

egress.terms: no monthly byte allowance is published; the FAQ names only tunnel count and a best-effort basis; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: 'Create, manage, and monitor tunnels programmatically' via a REST API; configurations are also downloadable from the dashboard
tooling: wg-quick; iproute2 for SIT/GRE; REST API claimed
chaining: one /64 per tunnel and a browser-free config download make it a fast way to give a single free VM a public address; three tunnels per account covers three instances.
binding_note: No byte meter, no rate and no quota is published: 'free forever'. The limits are shape limits the vocabulary does not name - 'Each account can create up to 3 active tunnels' and 'Each user receives a dedicated ::/64 IPv6 subnet' - so nothing here fails at 1 TiB/month. Reachability is IPv6-only, and SIT/GRE need a public IPv4.

identity_cost.detail: 'Sign in your way - Google, GitHub, or email. Privacy-first authentication with no vendor lock-in and no unnecessary tracking.'

reliability_note: hobby network, 'no SLA': 'This is a hobby project provided on a best-effort basis with no SLA.'
confidence_note: documented from the vendor pages read. Measuring would need a tunnel and a UDP service behind it.

evidence.proved: 'SIT & GRE and WireGuard tunnels - routed ::/64 prefix', 'POP London & Amsterdam - free forever'
'Each user receives a dedicated ::/64 IPv6 subnet automatically assigned from our address space.'
'Yes. Completely free for personal and testing use - no credit card, no contracts, no hidden fees.'
'Yes. A publicly reachable IPv4 address is required. NAT behind CGNAT will not work.'
'Full REST API - Create, manage, and monitor tunnels programmatically.'

notes: A /64 rather than a /48, which still gives every port and protocol but no room to subnet. The REST API is claimed on the landing page; the API documentation URL (?page=api) returned HTTP 504 on 2026-10-23, so whether an API can mint a WireGuard profile unattended is unestablished. Uplinks listed as Cilix Limited and Hurricane Electric LLC

extras.wg_detail: the dashboard hands out a profile: 'download your config from dashboard' then 'wg-quick up ~/tun-aXXX.conf'; the FAQ says 'We currently support SIT (6in4) and GRE or WireGuard tunnels'.
extras.volume_stated: no monthly byte allowance is published; the FAQ names only tunnel count and a best-effort basis
extras.transit_note: GhostTunnel on AS209552 carries the traffic, with Cilix Limited and Hurricane Electric LLC as upstreams.
